items.claim: Material 3 theming is organized around color scheme, typography, and shapes, with component styling derived from those theme systems.
Material 3 color theming starts from key colors that generate tonal palettes and semantic roles for components and surfaces.
items.notes: Role structure is more transferable than baseline hues.

items.claim: Material 3 defines display, headline, title, body, and label typography groups, each with large, medium, and small variants.
The system can remain recognizably Material while brand expression changes because semantic roles and component behavior are more stable than any one baseline palette.
